definitions.gloss: bureau staff; office worker; station employee
definitions.explanation: A person who works at a bureau, office, or station — most commonly a post office, broadcasting station, or government bureau. The specific workplace is determined by context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧{局員|きょくいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{聞|き}いた→聞く：00483_kiku⟧。
examples.english: I asked the post office clerk.

examples.japanese: ⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧{局員|きょくいん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧{十年|じゅうねん}⟦{働|はたら}いている→働く：00503_hataraku⟧。
examples.english: I have been working as a broadcasting station employee for ten years.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{局員|きょくいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{丁寧|ていねい}→丁寧：00896_teinei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{対応|たいおう}→対応：02510_taiou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: The clerk at the counter assisted me politely.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{局|きょく}→局：02687_kyoku⟧ ('bureau; office; station') and {員|いん} ('member; staff'). The suffix {員|いん} attaches to workplace or organization names to mean 'employee/member of': ⟦{銀行員|ぎんこういん}→銀行員：05058_ginkouin⟧ ('bank employee'), ⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧ ('company employee'), ⟦{駅員|えきいん}→駅員：05503_ekiin⟧ ('station staff').

USAGE:
- Without a modifier, {局員|きょくいん} most often refers to a post office worker, since ⟦{郵便局|ゆうびんきょく}→郵便局：00579_yuubinkyoku⟧ is the most frequently visited type of ⟦{局|きょく}→局：02687_kyoku⟧ in daily life.
- With modifiers: ⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧{局員|きょくいん} ('broadcasting station staff'), ⟦{薬局|やっきょく}→薬局：01069_yakkyoku⟧{局員|きょくいん} ('pharmacy staff').
- A practical word for daily errands — you interact with {局員|きょくいん} when sending packages, buying stamps, or picking up registered mail.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{郵便|ゆうびん}→郵便：03803_yuubin⟧{局員|きょくいん}: post office clerk
- ⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧{局員|きょくいん}: broadcasting station staff
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{局員|きょくいん}: the clerk at the counter

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{職員|しょくいん}→職員：20206_shokuin⟧: staff member; employee — a more general term for institutional employees
- ⟦{駅員|えきいん}→駅員：05503_ekiin⟧: station staff — specifically railway station workers
- ⟦{係員|かかりいん}→係員：27111_kakariin⟧: person in charge; attendant — the staff member responsible for a particular task or area
- ⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧: company employee — office worker at a private company
